selections.name: go-api-contracts
selections.reason: The task preserves exported function types, Go1.22, Put semantics, file/wire bytes, error identities, and CLI grammar/status/streams while adding supported operations.

selections.name: go-behavior-tests
selections.reason: The task adds consequential behavior and explicitly requests regression tests for success, rejection, accepted prefixes, retained bytes, processes, and lifecycle ordering.

selections.name: go-core-style
selections.reason: Production and test code are Go; use simple standard-library design, immediate error handling, gofmt, vet, and race checks.

selections.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selections.reason: Refresh borrows the supplied HTTP client, Serve owns refresh/release sequencing, and watch owns signal cancellation and transport cleanup.

selections.name: go-package-boundaries
selections.reason: The additions introduce fetching/publication and lifecycle responsibilities. Existing library and command packages suffice; no demonstrated split or new abstraction is needed.

selections.name: go-test-isolation
selections.reason: Tests own temporary files, real HTTP servers, child processes, file-size limits, channels, timers, callbacks, and signal-driven shutdown.

reference_relevance.behavior-observations.md: Read for failure after effects begin, independent work/release outcomes, and process/file observations with independent oracles.
reference_relevance.isolation-patterns.md: Read for child environment filtering, early-failure teardown, event-controlled timing, real HTTP cancellation, and Go1.22-compatible test APIs.

scope: Only the authorized dispatch, isolated module, offered relevant guidance, and this report directory were inspected. No delegation, dependency installation, commits, or external changes.
